title: Record an invoice payment
summary: Add payment to a confirmed invoice with a balance: opens the payment wizard with the invoice already chosen.

steps.title: Menu → Purchases → Purchase Invoices
steps.details: What the clinic owes a provider: it comes from a purchase quote or is entered/imported directly.

steps.title: Open the invoice
steps.details: Tap it in the list. The guide continues once its details open.

steps.title: Add payment
steps.details: It shows if the invoice is confirmed and has a balance left.

steps.title: Payment wizard
steps.details: Amount, payment method and currency. Cash payments come out of the open cash register (unless you check «historical»).
